title: Internet Browsing Basics
intro: Learn how to use the internet effectively, find information, use websites and browse safely.
topic1_text: Learn how websites, browsers and online services work together to provide information.
topic2_text: Learn how to search for information using keywords and choose reliable results.
topic3_text: Learn about bookmarks, history, downloads and useful browser settings.
topic4_text: Learn basic practices for protecting your information while browsing online.
practice: Practice searching for useful educational information online.
